theorems.statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [bA : Bialgebra k A] {H : Type*} [CommRing H] [HopfAlgebra k H] (ι : BialgHom k A H) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (hS : ∀ a : A, ∃ b : A, ι b = HopfAlgebra.antipode k (ι a)), ∃ hA : HopfAlgebra k A, hA.toHopfAlgebraStruct.toBialgebra = bA ∧ (letI : Algebra k A := hA.toHopfAlgebraStruct.toBialgebra.toAlgebra; letI : Module k A := Algebra.toModule; letI : Bialgebra k A := hA.toHopfAlgebraStruct.toBialgebra; letI : HopfAlgebra k A := hA; ∀ a : A, ι (HopfAlgebra.antipode k a) = HopfAlgebra.antipode k (ι a))
